Welcome to the Peak League!

Commanders who reach <color=#EC6D26>high Arena ranks</color> will qualify for the Peak League.

  The Peak League opens alongside the <color=#EC6D26>Arena Season</color>.
  The first 7 days of the season are the <color=#EC6D26>Registration Phase</color>. Qualified players will be <color=#EC6D26>automatically registered</color>, and may cancel registration at any time.
  The last 7 days are the <color=#EC6D26>Battle Phase</color>. Challenge other commanders and compete for more Crowns!

Attack Rules:
  1. Commanders in the league receive <color=#EC6D26>8 challenge attempts</color> each day.
  2. Please confirm your lineup before matchmaking. Soldiers <color=#EC6D26>cannot be changed</color> after a match is found.
  3. After matchmaking succeeds, battle must begin within <color=#EC6D26>180s</color>. Failing to start or leaving mid-battle counts as a defeat.
  4. Defeats grant <color=#EC6D26>no</color> points and deduct <color=#EC6D26>no</color> points.
  5. Battle points are calculated based on your <color=#EC6D26>Destruction Rate</color>. Higher Destruction Rates earn more points!

Defense Rules:
  1. Defenders must set up 3 defensive lineups to guard <color=#EC6D26>3 defense zones</color>.
  2. Each defense zone has a <color=#EC6D26>unique effect</color> that only applies to defenders.
  3. Attackers will <color=#EC6D26>randomly encounter</color> 1 of the 3 defensive lineups during matchmaking.

Welcome to Clan Hunt! Monsters rising from the abyss are ravaging this once-beautiful island. Unite your forces, drive the horrors back, and join the inter-clan hunting contest — slay beasts to rack up points and claim rich rewards.

1. Personal Points
You earn points by attacking any tile on the map.
If the tile you attack is owned by your own clan, the points you gain are doubled.

2. Clan Points
Every point earned by a clan member is converted to Clan Points at a fixed ratio.
When enemies occupying a clan-owned tile are defeated, the clan also receives an additional flat bonus of Clan Points.

3. Clan Progress Rewards
When your clan clears a specified cumulative number of tiles, the clan will receive an additional flat bonus of Clan Points.

4. Tile Difficulty
Tiles come in varying difficulty levels; tougher tiles host more formidable enemies.
When a tile is defeated, it will upgrade to a higher difficulty level. The maximum difficulty for Plains is [Hard], while the maximum difficulty for Highlands is [Insane].

5. Point Bonus
As a tile is attacked multiple times, the amount of Points earned from that tile increases.
It is recommended to focus clan attacks on a single tile.

6. Rewards
Compete to earn two prize tiers: Clan Rank rewards and Personal Rank rewards. Rewards are granted based on the clan you belong to when the event ends. If you leave your clan before the event concludes, your personal points will be reset to zero.
